_sobre: Pedido das fotos do site da Horizon para gerar_imagens.py. Os nomes são os mesmos arquivos de horizon/img/. Prompts em inglês: os modelos respondem melhor. Paleta da marca: azul #00193F e dourado #D6B83A.

imagens.prompt: Photorealistic cinematic wide image. Left third: deep navy blue night sky, dark and empty, leaving room for text. Center: planet Earth seen from orbit at night with South America facing the camera, glowing golden city lights and thin luminous gold arcs connecting the continents like a global trade network. Right side: a large modern container port at sunset seen from above, gantry cranes and stacked shipping containers, warm golden sky reflecting on the water. Color palette of deep navy blue and warm gold. High detail, premium corporate look. No text, no logos, no watermark.
